headline: Keep the News article kicker clear of the fixed page status ring

items.title: Keep the News article kicker clear of the fixed page status ring
items.insight: S404 actual mobile pixel review found the fixed status ring intersects THE ARGUMENT in all seven SpaceX article themes.
items.evidence: At360/390/430px and desktop1366px, both current article kicker text ranges avoid the actual status target in all7themes; mobile captures are visually inspected and existing article CSS tests pass. No obscured title, new clipping or hidden status link.
